advantage_contrast.definition: Pooled donor BA(CA) - BA(token_concat) at rho=1 with paired donor-bootstrap CI. Descriptive only.
advantage_contrast.label: SEPARATE_NON_PRIMARY
advantage_contrast.name: ca_minus_token_concat_pooled_ba

fitted_mechanism_null_gate.definition: Same pairing statistic at rho=0 must have CI lower <= 0; otherwise label INVALID (design/optimization leak), not a method claim.

evaluation.joint_rule: All seven arms must complete smoke+screen coverage before interpreting pairing. Incomplete coverage => INCOMPLETE.
evaluation.marginal_check: At rho=1, logreg_rna and logreg_atac donor BA <= 0.60; failure suggests unimodal/background shortcut.
outcome_precedence: INVALID if rho=0 pairing CI lower > 0
INVALID if rho=1 unimodal marginal BA FAIL
VALID_POSITIVE if rho=1 PAIRING_POSITIVE and marginal PASS and rho=0 null VALID
VALID_NEGATIVE if rho=1 PAIRING_NEGATIVE with rho=0 null VALID and marginal PASS

primary_statistic.definition: For CA at rho=1: mean donor log-loss(shuffled ATAC) - log-loss(original); average shuffle outcomes within donor across PAIRING_SHUFFLE_SEEDS, then paired donor-bootstrap 95% CI (1000 draws, seed 22). PAIRING_POSITIVE iff CI lower > 0.
primary_statistic.name: pairing_use_donor_logloss_drop

exclusions: No S9 rescue or re-label of historical INVALID
No seed shopping / outcome-driven threshold change
No NeMO development use / no external predictions
No ThreadPoolExecutor scientific dispatch unless later reviewed isolation proof

generation.correction_vs_s9: Removes exact w⊥z orthogonalization that placed ρ=0 planted pairs on measure-zero and broke shuffle exchangeability (R2).
generation.donor_label_equation: Reuse S9 assign_donor_labels: rank donor_ids by SHA256('s9-label\n'+generator_seed+'\n'+donor_id); first 12 → class 0, remaining 12 → class 1. Decision generator_seed=9301.
generation.nuisance_equation: Channels k∈{4..15}: independent Gaussian draws per view plus a donor-level mean shift (0.5 * SHA256-stable donor shift); tags use '_s10' suffixes. Independent of y_d and planted z.
generation.planted_equation: For each donor d and planted channel k∈{0..3}: draw z,w ~ N(0,I) from SHA256(generator_seed, donor_id, channel, 'z_s10'|'w_s10'); centre/scale each independently (NO orthogonalize). Set RNA[cells,k]=z and ATAC[cells,k]=(2*y_d-1)*rho*z + sqrt(1-rho^2)*w. At rho=0 ATAC planted = independent w (exchangeable under within-donor ATAC shuffle). At rho=1 ATAC planted = signed RNA.
generation.test_pairing_shuffle: Permute ATAC rows within each held-out donor using fixed PAIRING_SHUFFLE_SEEDS 4001–4016; preserve exact within-donor ATAC marginal row multiset; never shuffle across donors/labels.

hypothesis: Under the corrected independent-Gaussian ρ=0 null (no exact orthogonalization), does the seven-arm NN factory detect planted within-cell RNA/ATAC pairing via CA donor log-loss drop under within-donor ATAC shuffle, with a VALID exchangeable ρ=0 null gate?

models.reuse: Existing paired_model / model_inputs / train_model / fit_logistic / s7 pairing helpers; s10_analytic adds corrected generator only.
models.selection: Same inner-validation donor log-loss and identical available training budget for neural arms; no hyperparameter sweep.

null.statement: Under the corrected generator and within-donor ATAC shuffle at rho=0, CA must not yield PAIRING_POSITIVE (donor log-loss-drop 95% CI lower <= 0).

oracle.definition: Non-learned donor score = mean over cells of sum of planted-channel products RNA[k]*ATAC[k] for k=0..3. Predict class 1 iff score > 0.
oracle.role: Validates constructed pairing exists and is destroyed by within-donor ATAC shuffle. Does not validate learned models.

fit_arithmetic.note: Smoke counts as scientific (diagnostic allowance exhausted). Pairing shuffle interventions are not fits. Serial workers=1 default.

seeds.selection_rule: Prospective freeze before scientific outcomes; not chosen by S9 INVALID metrics or R2 diagnostic performance.
